identity.name: Data Analytics and BI
identity.description: Database views, ETL pipelines, and AWS QuickSight reports — business intelligence across regions.

goals: Maintain and expand business intelligence reporting via DB views, ETL pipelines, and AWS QuickSight
Deliver accurate, timely analytics that support business decisions across regions
Reduce manual report generation through better automation and self-service dashboards

milestones.name: Core QuickSight dashboards operational for all regions

risks.description: ETL pipelines break silently — reports show stale data without anyone noticing
risks.mitigation: Pipeline monitoring with alerts on failure or data staleness

risks.description: V8 MVP analytics project depends on V8 data quality which is inconsistent
risks.mitigation: Data validation layer in ETL; surface data quality issues rather than hiding them in reports

dependencies.description: V8 database is the primary data source for ETL and reporting

notes: Primarily UAE-focused. Covers DB views, ETL pipelines, and AWS QuickSight reports. The V8 MVP analytics project is a current workstream — AI read-only analytics layer over V8 data. Data quality from V8 is inconsistent, so the ETL layer must validate rather than blindly pass through. The instance guide lists this as 'DAB' (sometimes referred to as 'DABI' internally).
